cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import json
# adversarial: allgather D=1024 N=64, 250 snaps each preceded by one new slot contribution
K=4096; D=1024; N=64
evs=[]
# fill the window once: 64 slots x 4 sources
p=0
for r in range(4):
    evs.append({'op':'data','rank':r,'p':0,'count':N,'step':1})
# now 250 snaps, each preceded by a data packet that changes a slot (blocked data still changes nothing)
# use stale/blocked? no: to change the digest we accept new contributions -> but window is full.
# Instead: ack to retire, then new data.
for i in range(250):
    evs.append({'op':'snap','tag':'s%d'%i})
    evs.append({'op':'data','rank':0,'p':N+i,'count':1})   # blocked (p>=b+N) -> no state change
c={'primitive':'allgather','mode':3,'root':0,'segments':K,'words':D,'capacity':N,'start':0,'events':evs,'trace':0}
open('/tmp/big4.json','w').write(json.dumps({'cases':[c]}))
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'project')
from request import validate
print(validate({'cases':[c]}))
" && time (python3 -I -B project/solver.py < /tmp/big4.json > /tmp/o4.json) && head -c 200 /tmp/o4.json; echo
